_about: Single source of truth for key upcoming-event dates. Read by starship.js, calendar.js and live.js (homepage/Starship live card). Edit dates HERE only. MAJOR EVENTS: set "major": true on Roadster-reveal-level events (product reveals, Starship flights, major Tesla/SpaceX/xAI events). The homepage shows a big countdown for any major event starting within 7 days, until 30 min before start (then the Live now card takes over). Use either date(+precision/tz) or start/end ISO; entries with only start/end are not touched by live.js. Every entry needs a real source URL.

tesla-2026-asm.title: Tesla 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders

Virtual at virtualshareholdermeeting.com/TSLA2026, webcast at tesla.com/2026shareholdermeeting, limited in-person at Giga Texas. Record date 13 Oct 2026. tesla-2026-asm-draw.title: Tesla 2026 Annual Meeting in-person drawing deadline
tesla-2026-asm-draw.summary: Deadline to enter Tesla’s random drawing for limited in-person seats at the 3 Dec 2026 Annual Meeting: Fri 6 Nov 2026, 11:59 p.m. CT. Selections are communicated the week of 16 Nov.

starship-flight-16.title: Starship Flight 16
starship-flight-16.summary: December 2026 target, reported. FAA CADENA air-traffic planning slides (22 Oct) list Flight 16 NET 10 Dec 2026, as the first flight from Florida (LC-39A). NASASpaceflight (25 Oct) estimates the first LC-39A Starship flight could be in late January 2027. This is reporting, not a SpaceX date.

starship-flight-15.title: Starship Flight 15
starship-flight-15.summary: NET 8 November on FAA air-traffic planning slides, not a SpaceX T-0. On the 20 Oct earnings call Musk said SpaceX expects Flight 15 next month and will try to catch both the booster and the ship. Booster 22 completed a full-duration 33-engine static fire on 25 Oct, per SpaceX. NASASpaceflight and Next Spaceflight report a Ship 42 single-engine static fire at Massey’s on 26 Oct, then a six-engine, roughly 60-second full-duration fire on 27 Oct 2026, about 4:46pm CDT (about 21:46 Irish time). SpaceX hasn’t posted about the Ship 42 fires. Both Flight 15 vehicles have now static-fired. Still no FAA licence and no SpaceX date.
sources: FAA CADENA / air-traffic planning slides (NET 8 Nov)
Elon Musk, SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings call, 20 Oct 2026: Flight 15 'next month' (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/20/spacex-spcx-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/)
SpaceX on X, 25 Oct 2026: full-duration 33-engine static fire of the Flight 15 booster (https://x.com/SpaceX/status/2114444137067844004)
Next Spaceflight Ship 42 test log, including the 27 Oct six-engine static fire (https://www.nextspaceflight.com/starship/hardware/80/)
The Space Road: Flight 15 prep, citing the 27 Oct Massey’s fire (https://thespaceroad.com/articles/when-is-starship-flight-15/)

crs35-docking.title: Dragon · CRS-35 docked with the ISS
crs35-docking.summary: Docked 10:27 a.m. EDT to Harmony’s space-facing port with 6,300+ lb of cargo and the final IROSA pair. About 30 minutes ahead of the ~11:00 a.m. ET plan.
sources: NASA space station blog, 15 Oct 2026: docked at 10:27 a.m. EDT

tesla-roadster-demo.title: Tesla Roadster reveal
tesla-roadster-demo.summary: Past: Tesla revealed the next-gen Roadster on 15 Oct (16 Oct Irish time). Replay and write-up on the Dispatch.

spacex-q3-2026-earnings.title: SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings call
spacex-q3-2026-earnings.summary: Past: SpaceX reported Q3 2026 revenue of $14.58B and net income of $4.40B after the US close on Tue 20 Oct, then held its webcast at 3:30 p.m. CT. Replay on ir.spacex.com; write-up on the Dispatch.

tesla-q3-2026-earnings.title: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings call
tesla-q3-2026-earnings.summary: Past: Tesla reported Q3 2026 revenue of $28.05B, GAAP net income of $787M and free cash flow of $1.53B after the US close on Wed 21 Oct, then held its Q&A webcast at 4:30 p.m. CT. Replay on ir.tesla.com; write-up on the Dispatch.

ussf-481.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-481
ussf-481.summary: Liftoff ~5:02 p.m. PT (00:02 UTC 16 Oct); first stage landed on Of Course I Still Love You.

bandwagon-5.title: Falcon 9 · Bandwagon-5 rideshare
bandwagon-5.summary: Launched Tue 20 Oct at 7:04 a.m. ET from SLC-40, Cape Canaveral, with 32 payloads incl. SpaceX's second Starfall demo. The first stage, on its 19th flight, landed on A Shortfall of Gravitas.

spcx-q3-lockup-release.title: SpaceX lock-up release · up to 1.3B shares
spcx-q3-lockup-release.summary: Up to 1.3 billion SPCX shares (28% of the 180-day lock-up pool) became eligible for sale from the second full Nasdaq trading day after Q3 results, per the 424B4 prospectus. With results after the close on Tue 20 Oct, that was Thu 22 Oct.
